rows.statement: Who held final say on draft decisions across the 32 pro clubs in the 2016 ESPN NFL Nation survey, as general manager : head coach : owner or family member : other executive.

sources.citation: ESPN NFL Nation 2016 draft decision-maker survey, tallied in research/audit-r31-r34.md R35
sources.locator: /mnt/project-files/research/audit-r31-r34.md, R35 (the researcher's tally of the article's prose)
sources.quote: the general manager had final say in 21, the head coach in 5 (MIA, NE, ATL, LAR, SEA), an owner or family member in 4 (CIN, IND, SD/LAC, DAL), another executive in 2 (CLE, PHI)

sources.citation: Bleacher Report, Tyler Conway, '2016 NFL Draft Decision-Makers for Each Team Revealed by ESPN NFL Nation', 2016-04-18
sources.locator: https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2633712-2016-nfl-draft-decision-makers-for-each-team-revealed-by-espn-nfl-nation (32-team table, tallied by G-48; owner-family counts Cincinnati's president-owner and the Chargers' family president, as R35 does)
sources.quote: General managers comprise an overwhelming majority of the final say.

rows.notes: Both sources relay one survey, so they are one independence group. The article text says four head coaches; its own table lists five (Atlanta included). Ten years old: used as a starting distribution only (L5.2.1).

statusHistory.reason: G-48 load; Bleacher Report table read 2026-11-26 confirms the R35 tally.
